| Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top three cards, and stack them face-up here. == Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Evacuation Control (V)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
